images.alt: A wide sandy river bed with a shallow channel of water and trees on the far bank, in the dry season
images.caption: The Mitchell at the Koolatah–Dunbar crossing in the dry season, on the lower-middle river well below Karma Waters: the same sand bed, pools and tree fringe as the upper reach, on a bigger scale.
images.location: Koolatah–Dunbar crossing, Mitchell River, Cape York Peninsula

images.alt: A satellite radar image of a river system branching across a flat plain towards the coast
images.caption: The lower Mitchell and its fan of channels seen by the Sentinel-1 radar satellite on 17 February 2022, in the wet season: the river Karma Waters sits at the top of, spread across the Gulf plains towards Kowanyama and the sea.
images.credit: Image: Monja Šebela / Sentinel Hub, containing modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2022), via Wikimedia Commons
images.location: Lower Mitchell River and delta, Gulf of Carpentaria
